verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Integration Console, a self-service tool that gives real-time feedback on your API integration, plus a Riskified-run data-validation phase before an account goes live. Together these suggest a pre-production testing path. Neither is described as a sandbox isolated from production data. missing for 10: an explicitly documented sandbox/staging environment or endpoint, separate test credentials, a guarantee that test traffic doesn't touch production data or models, test fixtures for simulating decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
